summary.text: A. Reece Pyrtle, Jr. is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 65 (Rockingham County), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 2.5 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists A. Reece Pyrtle, Jr.'s occupation as Retired - Police Chief (City of Eden).
